title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1031 | 水豚三胞胎、百机器人齐舞、鸟鸣似人歌
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🦫 苏格兰一家动物园的水豚妈妈 Luna 一下子生了三只宝宝，哥哥 Bru 一下子成了三个娃的哥哥！
🤖 中国有一百一十个机器人同时一起跳舞，还排出了 2026 的造型，创下世界纪录！
🐦 科学家听了三百五十多种鸟的歌，发现鸟鸣和人唱歌居然有一样的规律！

📖 Word of the day: synchronized（同步的；整齐划一地一起动）

🎮 二选一：跟三只水豚宝宝一起游泳，还是跟一百一十个机器人一起跳舞？你选哪个？也问问爸爸妈妈！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🦫 A capybara mom in Scotland just had three babies at once!
🤖 One hundred ten robots danced together at exactly the same time and set a world record!
🐦 Scientists listened to more than three hundred fifty kinds of birds and found birdsong shares patterns with human song!

📖 Word of the day: synchronized

🎮 Would you rather swim with three baby capybaras, or dance with one hundred ten robots? Ask your mom and dad too!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. synchronized（同步的）
moving together at exactly the same time
例：dance in synchronized steps（步调一致地跳舞）

2. rodent（啮齿动物）
an animal like a mouse, a rat, or a capybara, with teeth that keep growing
例：a capybara is the biggest rodent（水豚是最大的啮齿动物）

3. triplet（三胞胎中的一个）
one of three babies born at the same time
例：a triplet stays close to mom（三胞胎宝宝紧挨着妈妈）

4. rhythm（节奏）
a steady beat in music or song
例：a steady rhythm（平稳的节奏）
